description:
Verify a BIP-340 Schnorr signature over a 32-byte digest. Takes the digest, signature, and public key, returns whether the signature is valid. Use for verifying Taproot signatures from other agents in multisig coordination.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

publicKey.description: 32-byte hex-encoded x-only public key of the signer

name: schnorr_verify_digest
